title: Bhaiya Ali Akbar
body:
baba ki zaeefi pe nazar kar lo to jao
bhaiya ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane lagi maqtal ko jo akbar ki sawari
kohraam bapa hogaya sheh kehte thay zaari
zainab ne jigar thaam liya farte alam se
lipti hui daaman se sakina ye pukari
<<DIVIDER>>
aise nahi jaao
aankhon mein chupe ashk na tum hum se chupao
bhaiya ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya tumhe maloom hai baba hai akele
tooti hai kamar baba ki sadme se chacha ke
us dard ki shiddat ko khudara na badhao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
maangi thi dua hum ne to din byaah ke aaye
kya khabr thi tabeer ne kya rang dikhaye
mujh par na sahi tars phupi jaan pe khao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba se nahi rukte to mai kis tarha rokun
tehro zara dam nad e ali seene pe kardun
ho sakta hai mushkil se nikal kar chale aao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
phoolon ka nahi ashkon ka sehra hi sajalun
sughra ki taraf se mai armaan nilakun
kya kehdun khat e sughra jo aaye ye batao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ki taraf dekh ke maango zara ruqsat
khul jayegi seene mein hai kitni tere taaqat
sar apna jhukaye huwe nazrein na churao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaan gayi tum bhi na aaoge palat kar
mai choti behan hoo mere majaye baradar
baba ki tarha seene pe ek baar sulao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote huwe maqtal ko rawana huwe akbar
saanson ko sambhale huwe peeche chale sarwar
awaaz e sakina thi na baba ko rulao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan o raza kya wo qayamat ka samaan tha
jab seena e akbar mein laga zulm ka naiza
kehti thi sakina mere dil pe laga ghao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
author: Rehaan Azmi
